hooks.command: set -e; payload="$(cat)"; cmd="$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')"; if [ -z "$cmd" ]; then exit 0; fi; offenders="$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oE 'backend/hrapp-service/src/main/java/com/company/hr/[A-Za-z0-9_/-]+\.java' | awk -F/ '{print $NF" "$0}' | awk '$1 !~ /^Hr/ {print $2}')"; if [ -n "$offenders" ]; then printf 'BLOCKED: backend Java class names must start with Hr. Offending paths:\n%s\n' "$offenders" 1>&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

set -e; payload="$(cat)"; cmd="$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')"; if [ -z "$cmd" ]; then exit 0; fi; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])rm[[:space:]]+-rf[[:space:]]+(/|~|\$HOME)([[:space:]]|$)'; then printf 'BLOCKED: dangerous rm -rf detected.
' 1>&2; exit 2; fi; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+(--force|-f)([[:space:]]+(origin[[:space:]]+)?(main|master|release/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+))'; then printf 'BLOCKED: force push to a protected branch.
' 1>&2; exit 2; fi; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE '(DROP[[:space:]]+(TABLE|DATABASE))'; then printf 'BLOCKED: destructive SQL detected.
' 1>&2; exit 2; fi; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'chmod[[:space:]]+-R[[:space:]]+777'; then printf 'BLOCKED: chmod -R 777 detected.
' 1>&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

set -e; payload="$(cat)"; tool="$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty')"; path="$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty')"; case "$tool" in Edit|Write) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$path" in frontend/src/*.ts|frontend/src/*.tsx|frontend/src/**/*.ts|frontend/src/**/*.tsx) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; rel="${path#frontend/}"; (cd frontend && npx --no-install eslint --fix "$rel") 1>&2 || printf 'eslint reported issues for %s\n' "$rel" 1>&2; exit 0
printf 'Active runtime: PostgreSQL on backend port 18082, frontend port 5182. Use `cd backend && ./build-jersey-service.sh test` for backend tests.\n'

set -e; status="$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ -n "$status" ]; then printf 'WARNING: uncommitted changes at session end:
%s
' "$status" 1>&2; else printf 'Working tree clean.
' 1>&2; fi; exit 0
set -e; payload="$(cat)"; name="$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.subagent_name // .agent // "unknown"')"; printf 'Subagent finished: %s\n' "$name" 1>&2; exit 0

set -e; payload="$(cat)"; msg="$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.message // .notification // ""')"; mkdir -p .claude; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$msg" >> .claude/notification-log.local; exit 0
